svg.desc: AgriLens LLM Benchmark. Full text is available in PROFILE.md.

g.text: Inspecting what local language models get right—and wrong
A local-LLM evaluation project comparing models on the same agricultural dataset. An
interactive explorer makes saved responses, errors, and per-crop results available for
The emphasis is on evaluation: comparing outputs against the data and understanding
failure patterns. The browser presents recorded experiments; model runs use Ollama
